# Contributing to Endless Map

Thanks for helping! Endless Map is a one-person hobby project, so the most useful help is a good bug report.

## Report a bug

In the game (from 1.6.1): map menu > **Report a bug**. Copy the report and the form link, open the link and paste the
report - the game and the add-on's version are already filled in. Or open the
[bug form](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) here.

What helps most: what you did, what you expected, what happened instead, and a screenshot when the map looks wrong.

## Suggest an idea

[Open an issue](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/issues/new) and describe what you would like the map to do, and
in which game: retail or WoW Forever.

## Pull requests

This repository holds the released versions: each release replaces `AzerothUnrolled/` with that version's files, one
commit per version. So a pull request isn't merged as it is, but it is a welcome way to show a fix or an idea: a good
change goes into the next release, with credit. For anything bigger than a small fix, please open an issue first.

Contributions are under the add-on's licence,
[GPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/blob/main/LICENSE).

## Be kind

Everyone here follows the [code of conduct](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
Security problems are reported privately, as the
[security policy](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md) explains.
